picks.title: De Marque to Offer AI Audiobook Capabilities Via ElevenLabs
picks.excerpt: Seeking to increase the availability of non-English-language audiobooks, the Quebec-based distributor will now allow publishers in its network to put out audio titles with automated narration on the subscription-based ElevenReader platform.
picks.rationale: The most actionable item: a major distributor is opening AI-narrated audiobook distribution to its whole publisher network. No De Marque story in the ledger; the 09-25 Frankfurt card only mentioned ElevenLabs exhibiting.

picks.title: As Publishers Ramp Up AI Implementation, Employees Slow Down
picks.excerpt: Data from 771 professionals surveyed by the Book Industry Study Group and BookNet Canada found publishers' AI use at the organizational level jumped to 63%, from 48% in 2025, while individual use dropped from 46% in 2025 to 38% today.
picks.rationale: New results from the BISG/BookNet 2026 survey: organizational AI use rose to 63% while individual use fell to 38%. Only the June survey launch appears in the ledger; these results have not been published.

picks.title: 출판계 "출판물에 AI 활용 정도 밝히는 '표시 제도' 도입하자"
picks.excerpt: 종이책, 전자책, 오디오북 등 출판물에 인공지능(AI) 활용 정도를 밝히는 표시 제도를 적극 도입하자는 의견이 출판계에서 나왔다. 'AI 출판물 표시제도'를 도입하면 저자 또한 출판사에 자신이 원고에 어떤 AI를 얼마나 사용했는지 밝혀 계약서에 명시하게 된다.
picks.rationale: Twelve Korean publishing and authors' groups issued AI-use principles with tiered AI labelling. This is the single pick for a story three outlets covered; 한겨레 was chosen over Seoul Economic Daily and 연합뉴스 because it has the most detail on labelling and contracts and a usable og_image.

picks.title: "AI가 내 책을 얼마나 인용했는지 눈으로 확인한다" - 멘탯 전병욱 대표
picks.excerpt: [AI 도서 라이선싱 기업 멘탯 대표 전병욱] AI가 세상의 지식을 흡수해 답을 내놓는 시대, 출판·학술 콘텐츠 업계의 위기감은 어느 때보다 높다.
picks.rationale: AI book licensing with citation tracking that shows publishers how much AI draws on their titles. Mentat does not appear in the ledger, and the piece gives publishers a concrete path to revenue from AI use of their books.

picks.title: Publisher: AI will come for translators and illustrators first
picks.excerpt: Publishing house Tänapäev's editor-in-chief told ERR that original manuscripts written with AI remain rare, but the technology has already made its way into translation and illustration.
picks.rationale: A first-hand account from an Estonian publisher of where AI actually enters the book workflow. It adds a fifth outlet and a European view, and is distinct from the 09-29 Korean translator card (different country and source, about the publisher's workflow rather than translator pay).
